title: pvCellDatatoPointData
body:
## pvCellDatatoPointData

Converts cell-centred arrays to point-centred arrays by averaging, at each point, the values of the cells that use it; the output has the same dataset type. Needed before operations that require point data, such as contouring, streamline tracing or smooth colouring of solver results stored per cell. It is the native filter behind cellToPoint, which keeps the cell data by Schemaxis default; pvCellDatatoPointData keeps ParaView's defaults, which convert all arrays and drop the original cell arrays.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Averaging smooths discontinuities such as shocks or material interfaces; keep the cell data (PassCellData) when exact cell values matter.
- With PieceInvariant false (default), values at partition boundaries can differ between MPI processes.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CellDatatoPointData`. Identity: `filters/CellDataToPointData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Data to Point Data filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellDataArraytoprocess` | Add a cell array by name to be converted to point array. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PassCellData` | If this property is set to 1, then the input cell data is passed through to the output; otherwise, only the generated point data will be available in the output. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PieceInvariant` | If the value of this property is set to 1, this filter will request ghost levels so that the values at boundary points match across processes. NOTE: Enabling this option might cause multiple executions of the data source because more information is needed to remove internal surfaces. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ProcessAllArrays` | The value of this property controls whether all input cell arrays will be processed and converted into point arrays. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"

```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCellDatatoPointData",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
